sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You will wake up feeling determined and decisive today, says Ganesha. Be careful as your rigid views may make you seem stubborn. You may not be willing to come half way during a conflict and will make a habit of articulating your viewpoint. Tension at the workplace will eat through most of your time today, feels Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: A misunderstanding between the two of you will ultimately prove beneficial in the long run. Why? Today would be a good day to write a letter to the person in question. You're likely to find the results gratifying.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Temptations emerge unexpectedly as the Sagittarius Sun aligns with Pluto and Uranus, dearest Taurus, challenging your ability to stay strong. Watch your spending, or you could succumb to impulse purchases that compromise long-term financial goals. Your focus shifts toward more productive topics once Mars enters Virgo later today, inspiring you to take on a creative project or learn a new skill throughout the coming weeks. Though you'll be eager to act, think through your plan before moving ahead. The Gemini Moon offers a balanced perspective, forming supportive aspects with the Nodes of Fate, Venus, Jupiter, and Chiron as evening unfolds.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: You will have abundance of energy- but work pressure seems to get you irritated. Financial problems ruin your ability to think constructively. Get everybody to your big party-You'll have that extra bit of energy today which will make you organize events for your group. Do not sign any business/legal document without reading between the lines. Rituals/hawans/auspicious ceremonies will be performed at home. In a regular married life, this day will act as a delicious dessert.

readings.text: Ganesha likes to call this a power day as your innate qualities will come to the fore. You will be able to manage your tasks smoothly and meet deadlines by getting systematic. Your practical approach will find out the root cause of things.

Be conservative with your words today. If you are not careful, you are apt to give something away that you shouldn't. In short, you have some special information that someone else wants. Use this to your advantage. Your secrets are valuable.

readings.text: This is the right time to think about setting aside a sum in some fixed deposit schemes or in something that gives you regular returns. You will avoid taking financially risky decisions.

You're poised to take advantage of new opportunities. Your masculine and feminine energies are working together, which has a positive effect on your bottom line. Your shared investments and property may require some action on your part. Just wait a few days before signing any paperwork or agreements.

readings.text: Today you will remain focussed on your health. In the morning, you shall go for a jog, or exercise at home. After shedding some calories, and consuming a healthy breakfast, you shall obviously feel peppy and your productivity will scale new heights.

The alignment of the planets today makes you feel more confident and at the same time, perhaps a little bit high strung. Emotions are fluctuating and hard to put into compartments. You tend to want to give a name to things and be able to organize like with like. You may feel frustrated, therefore, if you feel more emotional in areas where you are accustomed to feeling "organized." The aspect at play tends to bring out the irrational. Use exercise to help feel more in control.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: Today is all about endurance -- it's time to stretch your expectations of yourself.
